Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of a northbound roadway in Houston, Texas, waiting for traffic to clear, when
the vehicle directly behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 is listed as the named
insured on the policy involved, and the responding officer confirmed Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the
scene. A Passenger was also present in the vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with
whiplash, and the officer noted that the reported symptoms fit the type and force of a rear impact of this kind. The rear
bumper and trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle showed damage that lines up with the described collision, and no earlier
damage to the vehicle was known to the officer or to Driver 1. Scene photographs confirm several details of the
impact and positions of both vehicles. No independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the
statements of the drivers and the physical evidence at the scene. Both vehicles were moved to the shoulder, and
traffic was directed around the area until the scene was cleared.
